_about: OBEX Dune-oracle results from reference/obex_monthly_pnl.sql, refreshed via Dune MCP on 2026-06-09 (query 7683607, v4). Three methodology fixes vs the original 2026-04-27 capture: (1) the debt sum now UNIONs vat.frob + vat.grab (ALLOCATOR-OBEX-A has duty=0, rate ≡ 1, so the entire stability-fee accrual flows through grab); (2) agent_demand no longer subtracts cum_sub_usds — subproxy USDS is treasury/risk capital, BR accrues on it; (3) BR / agent rate APYs now read SSR live from sUSDS file() traces instead of a hardcoded CASE ladder (replaces the stale ladder that caused the 2026-05 outlier). After these three fixes the oracle matches the pipeline to the penny on sky_revenue and agent_rate across Jan-May 2026.
_methodology_notes: Oracle uses prices.day for syrupUSDC valuation (DEX VWAP). Our pipeline uses convertToAssets (canonical NAV) — accounts for the documented ~$220K prime_agent_revenue diff.
Oracle includes vat.grab events alongside vat.frob in the cum_debt sum (refreshed 2026-06-09 v2).
Oracle's agent_demand no longer subtracts cum_sub_usds — matches the pipeline's utilised formula (refreshed v3).

Oracle reads SSR live from sUSDS file() traces (refreshed v4). Closes the stale-ladder gap that caused the 2026-05 outlier; oracle and pipeline now match to the penny on sky_revenue + agent_rate across Jan-May 2026.
Both pipelines use APY with per-second compounding (POWER((1 + apy), 1/365) - 1).
